title: Veterans Pension Rate Redetermination — One-Time Payments by Age of the Declaration
content:
# One-time payments in a redetermined Veterans Pension rate

In the redetermination of the annual Veterans Pension going forward, one-time payments are counted in countable income by the age of the veteran's declaration — his most recently received declaration of one-time payments, aged in days from the date VA received it to the redetermination.

| Declaration received | One-time payments counted |
|---|---|
| within the fresh period of 90 days | the declared amount, in full |
| after 90 days but within one year (365 days) | the declared amount times the months left of its twelve-month year, divided by 12, rounded to the cent; the months left are 12 less the whole months since receipt |
| no declaration within one year | none |

## Examples (hypothetical declaration of 7200.00)

- Received 45 days ago: 7200.00 counted.
- Received 200 days ago, 6 whole months: 7200.00 times 6 divided by 12, which is 3600.00.
- Received 380 days ago: none counted.
